text: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局城市司首席统计师董莉娟：7月份，受国际输入性因素影响，居民消费价格指数（CPI）环比下降0.1%，同比上涨0.5%，扣除食品和能源价格的核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同比上涨0.9%，CPI总体保持温和上涨。国内部分行业需求增加，但受输入性和季节性等因素影响，工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）环比下降0.7%，同比上涨3.5%，涨幅比上月回落0.6个百分点。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 9 - NBS Chief Statistician of the Urban Department Dong Lijuan: In July, affected by international input factors, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) fell 0.1% month-on-month and rose 0.5% year-on-year. Excluding food and energy prices, the core CPI rose 0.3% month-on-month and 0.9% year-on-year, with the CPI maintaining a moderate increase overall. Domestic demand in some industries increased, but due to input and seasonal factors, the Producer Price Index (PPI) fell 0.7% month-on-month and rose 3.5% year-on-year, with the increase down 0.6 percentage points from the previous month.
